sights.address: Vilas Park, north shore of Lake Wingra, Madison, WI
sights.w: Madison's small, quiet fifth lake between the Arboretum and Vilas Park: a sandy beach, fishing piers, paddling, and winter skating on the lagoon; next to the free Henry Vilas Zoo.

sights.n: Ice Age Complex at Cross Plains (Ice Age National Scenic Trail)
sights.address: 8075 Old Sauk Pass Rd, Cross Plains, WI
sights.w: National Park Service unit of the Ice Age National Scientific Reserve — 161 acres at the edge of the last glacier's reach (moraine, gorge and the Driftless boundary), with the Ice Age Trail's interpretive site.
